messages:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing 2.15 deploy windows across regions. We need explicit cutoffs for the version bump, changelog freeze, and DB migration. Proposed schedule (UTC):
```
Region    Canary start (UTC)    Full rollout start (UTC)    PR merge cutoff (UTC)
US-west   2026-03-20 02:00      2026-03-20 03:00              2026-03-19 23:00
EU        2026-03-20 08:00      2026-03-20 09:00              2026-03-20 05:00
APAC      2026-03-20 20:00      2026-03-20 21:30              2026-03-20 17:30
```
Callouts: DB migration is non-blocking for canary but requires final migration before APAC full rollout. Rolling back APAC will require coordination with on-prem teams. @release-captain please ack and confirm oncall windows. TL;DR: cut PR merges at the listed times; start canaries as listed. :point_up:

alex: Ack. Quick question — are hotfixes allowed after cut? I have a small patch that needs to go in if we allow a fast-track.

maria: We can allow hotfixes via release-captain-approved cherry-pick only. Ping me + @release-captain with the PR link and a short justification. :white_check_mark:

jin: DB migration plan: added a preflight job — `./scripts/migrate --dry-run` in pipeline. Will run on canary nodes at canary start. If migration takes >20m we hold. @sam fyi for schema change.

sam: Noted. I have one PR requiring a migration flag — will add a feature flag and send for review today. Can someone review #4521? :pray:

leo: I'll take #4521 after lunch. Also adding monitoring alert `deploy.migration.latency > 15m` to Ops dashboard.

devops-bot: Pipeline scheduled: 2.15-canary-us at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z

maria: FYI — changelog freeze: please add final entries by 2026-03-19 21:00 UTC so we can generate release notes. Use the `release-notes` label. Automation will cut notes at freeze.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/deploys (see sections: rollback, db-migration, post-mortem checklist)

alex: One more: what's the expected rollback assessment window for EU? I'm thinking 30m assessment + 15m rollback — is that ok?

maria: Yes — plan for 45m total. Trigger rollback if error rate >3% or core latency increase >200ms sustained >5m.

release-captain: Acked. I'll triage any post-freeze hotfix requests. Please make sure any migration PRs target `release/2.15` branch and include a migration toggle and rollback steps in the PR description.

jin: Quick commands to run before merging: `git ls-remote origin release/2.15` and `./scripts/check-deploy-locks.sh` — run these to confirm branch state and lock status.

sam: I'll run a preflight checklist and post results here around 2026-03-19 20:00 UTC. If anything blocks I'll tag @release-captain.

maria: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock the schedule tomorrow and post final times in #eng-releases. Thanks everyone :rocket:
